title: Jamaican Christmas Pudding
description: A traditional Jamaican dessert made with roasted ingredients, perfect for the holiday season.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the brown sugar, flour, dried fruit, eggs, rum or rum extract, vanilla extract, cinnamon, and allspice.
Mix well until all the ingredients are well combined.
Pour the mixture into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 45-50 minutes, or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream if desired.
